notice: SYNTHETIC DEMO POLICY. Not legal advice and not the policy of any real council. Section text is written for this hackathon demo only.

01.description: Parked in a restricted street during prescribed hours

11.description: Parked without payment of the parking charge

12.description: Parked in a residents' or shared use parking place without a valid permit

05.description: Parked after the expiry of paid for time

40.description: Parked in a designated disabled person's parking place without displaying a valid disabled person's badge

references.title: Representation window
references.text: Representations should be received within the representation window stated in the policy parameters, measured from the notice date. Late representations may still be considered at the officer's discretion.

references.title: Valid payment at the time of contravention
references.text: Where a verified payment record covers the vehicle, location zone and time of the alleged contravention, the representation should normally be accepted.

references.title: Grace period after paid time
references.text: A notice for parking after paid time must not be issued until the grace period in the policy parameters has elapsed after the paid time expired.

references.title: Valid permit
references.text: Where a verified permit record shows a permit valid for the vehicle and zone at the time of the alleged contravention, the representation should normally be accepted.

references.title: Permit not displayed but valid
references.text: A first occurrence of a valid permit that was not displayed may be accepted at the officer's discretion; repeated occurrences should normally be rejected.

references.title: Disabled person's badge
references.text: Where a verified badge record shows a valid badge for the time of the alleged contravention, the representation should normally be accepted. A badge that had expired should normally be rejected.

references.title: Loading and unloading
references.text: Loading or unloading activity may be accepted where it is supported by documentary evidence such as a delivery note and the observation period was not exceeded by a significant margin.

references.title: Observation period
references.text: For contraventions with a minimum observation period, a notice issued before that period elapsed should normally be cancelled.

references.title: Signage and lines
references.text: Claims that signs or road markings were missing, obscured or unclear require supporting photographic evidence and should be referred for a site check if the evidence is credible.

references.title: Mitigating circumstances
references.text: Claims of medical emergency or vehicle breakdown should be supported by documentary evidence. Unsupported mitigation should normally be rejected; credible but incomplete mitigation should be referred for further review.

references.title: Insufficient information
references.text: Where the facts needed to decide a representation are missing or inconsistent, the case should be referred for further review rather than decided.
